headings.strategy: Impactful, technical, tight tracking (tracking-tighter). Used for hero and section headers.

body.strategy: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for paragraphs and UI text.

mono.strategy: Used for performance numbers, data points, and technical labels to give an industrial/engineering feel.

scale.mono_label: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-primary

visual_enhancers.custom_cursor: Framer Motion tracking cursor. Default: small glowing amber dot with a subtle gradient trail. Hover state (interactive elements): transforms into a scanner bracket [ ] framing the element.
visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Fixed overlay with low-opacity SVG noise texture (pointer-events-none) to add industrial grit and prevent flat blacks.
visual_enhancers.kinetic_typography: Hero headline uses masked line-by-line reveal (Framer Motion). Text lines start at y: 100% wrapped in overflow-hidden spans, animating to y: 0.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky navigation: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a delicate 1px border-white/10 bottom stroke.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-32 for standard sections, gap-8 to gap-12 in grids. Container max-width to hold content while 3D spans viewport.
layouts.problems_grid: Bento Grid strategy (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Cards use 1px subtle borders, dark surface backgrounds, and a subtle amber ambient glow on hover.
layouts.hero_layout: 100vh sticky container. The 3D canvas lives at z-0. Typography and UI overlay at z-10, pointer-events-none (except for buttons).

3d_strategy.scene_description: A low-poly stylized warehouse environment. Initially chaotic (floating/misaligned boxes). A small stylized AGV robot is the focal point.
3d_strategy.scroll_interaction: Driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub: true. As the user scrolls, the AGV robot moves forward, and the chaotic boxes smoothly snap into an organized grid structure. Camera slowly tracks the robot.
3d_strategy.lighting: Dark moody ambient light with strong amber/orange spotlights pointing down onto the AGV and key warehouse racks, creating long dramatic shadows.
3d_strategy.mobile_fallback: Respects prefers-reduced-motion. On mobile, use a lighter 3D scene (fewer meshes) or a static cinematic render with simple parallax to ensure performance.

motion.scroll_engine: Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling, crucial for feeling premium.
motion.interactions: Buttons use aggressive industrial hover states: dark background to primary color fill, sharp edges. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with an amber box-shadow glow.
motion.counters: Performance numbers use framer-motion useSpring/useTransform to count up exactly when scrolled into view.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA against #080808. Use #A1A1A1 for secondary text, never pure gray.
accessibility.motion: Implement a hook to check prefers-reduced-motion; disable 3D scrub and fall back to static high-res renders if true.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cta-hero-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three, gsap, @studio-freight/react-lenis, framer-motion, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee.
instructions_to_main_agent.development: Ensure Lenis is wrapped around the application. Create a Global Canvas component for the 3D scene that spans 100vh and sticks using GSAP. For the 3D elements, generate simple BoxGeometries for the warehouse shelves/boxes and a simple grouped mesh for the 'AGV robot'. Animate them via useFrame and GSAP ScrollTrigger.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_elements: Build the custom cursor component early and apply it globally. Ensure the 3D canvas does not block pointer events for HTML buttons. Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards; build custom HTML/Tailwind divs with exact borders and paddings to match the 'Industrial' aesthetic.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. This is an Awwwards-level site, it must feel cinematic and technical.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text that overlap with images/3D.
Avoid centering large paragraphs of text; left-align them to maintain an editorial, technical flow.
Create depth using subtle border outlines (1px border-white/10) rather than heavy drop shadows.
Use pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons with aggressive hover states (e.g., text color changing, background filling with #FF5C00).
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
